description.value:
Hypellos are a race of amphibian creatures from the land of Spira, agile in the water but not so nimble on dry land.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Hypellos gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution.
  • Type: Hypellos are Humanoid creatures with a hypello subtype.
  • Size: Hypellos are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
  • Base Speed: Hypellos have a base speed of 20 feet, never modified by armor or encumbrance, and a swim speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Hypellos begin play speaking Common and Hypello. Hypellos with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Moogle, Goblin, Sylvan, Dwarven.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Camouflage: Hypellos receive a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks in marshes and forested areas.
  • Hardy: Hypellos gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Amphibians: Hypellos can breathe both air and water.
  • Animal Empathy: Hypellos gain a +2 racial bonus to all Handle Animal checks.
  • Rider: Hypellos gain a +2 racial bonus on Ride checks.
  • Ride ze Shoopuf?: Hypellos treat Handle Animal and Ride as class skills.
  • Swim: Hypellos have a swim speed of 30 feet and gain the +8 racial bonus on swim checks.

Movement Racial Traits

  • Swamp Stride: A hypello can move through difficult terrain at normal speed while within a swamp.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Darkvision: Hypellos can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Poor Communication: Hypellos gain a -2 to Diplomacy and Intimidation checks against all other races.
